dedupe_keys.name: microscale grid reactive decentralized systems μgrids

description: Microscale Grid Reactive Decentralized Systems (µGRiDS) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Institute for Sustainable Energy Systems (Hochschule Offenburg). Operational analysis of various building energy plants with focus on component level interactions for application in closed loop simulation of the control signals from a model predictive supervisory controller. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Methodical focus: Building Energy Plants, Plant Level Operational Analysis, Component Interactions. Time resolution: annual, hour, 15 min, 1 min. Software: Modelica. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
